component.name: Snim
component.summary: Screenshot, screen recording, OCR and upload tool

description.p: Snim captures an area, a window or the whole screen from the tray or a global hotkey, opens the shot in an annotation editor and uploads it to your own storage.

ul.li: Annotation editor with arrows, shapes, freehand, text, highlight, blur and step numbers
Screen recording with a webcam bubble, a trim editor and GIF or WebP export
OCR text snip that copies recognized text straight to the clipboard
Uploads to S3-compatible storage, SFTP and FTP with named destination profiles
Global hotkeys for every capture action
Instant, dialog-free captures on KDE Plasma

description.p: Print Screen can now open Snim, in one click on Windows, macOS and KDE. New default hotkeys leave browser shortcuts alone, hotkey problems show up in Settings, and screen recordings on Linux play back smoothly at a steady frame rate.
First release candidate, with Linux packages for Debian, Ubuntu and Fedora, a Flatpak, a notarized macOS DMG and a Windows installer.
